digest.component_or_area: store write seam and event validation
propositions: Event bodies containing live credential strings are accepted by the store and published via auto-push, causing GitHub push protection to reject the branch and wedge all concurrent agent writes (153 commits queued local-only from one comment)

The store write path has multiple seams not all covered by append_event: reconciler inbound translate calls finalize_event halves directly to write untrusted external Jira COMMENT/EDIT bodies, bypassing any screen at append_event alone

A deterministic pure-function secret screen must live at _seam.finalize_event and refuse writes containing high-confidence credential patterns, with an audited force override to handle false positives on descriptions of credentials
The screen must not echo secrets into exception messages, stderr, logs, or on-disk events; payloads dict keys must be redacted in field paths to prevent credential-as-key leaks

Patterns use fixed-width windows rather than greedy quantifiers to prevent same-class padding from diluting entropy below detection threshold; PEM patterns are line-anchored to avoid matching prose enumerations
Inbound reconciler routing must be changed to call finalize_event rather than its halves, with a regression test ensuring the routing cannot be bypassed again
